provider: CUHK BMED Mathematics and Mathematics Education official Programme and Course List
academicYear: Study Scheme applicable to students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter; current Course List reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The official BMED Programme page publishes a 147-unit degree for students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter: 102 Major Programme units made up of 47 Mathematics Related Course units and 55 Faculty of Education Course units, plus 45 University Requirement units. The Programme-specific Course List publishes 75 unique code-title-unit rows in five named areas: seven Educational Studies, nine Pedagogy Courses, two Research Experience, 55 Subject Knowledge and two Teaching Practice courses. The downloaded Course List HTML was 80,167 bytes with SHA-256 beaff312f53b4ede9136ff1b50177e0c61e4473737b8461f999f253f291be67b; the Programme HTML was 67,277 bytes with SHA-256 8fc0b361a34930f30b52f3bbe370456307522e6080b1e3b4d959f56d93fd1590. The 75 published rows total 225 units, far above the 102-unit Major requirement, and the public pages do not identify the closed per-course required/alternative/elective choices, the Science Faculty Package codes, or Year/Term placement. Every row is therefore exposed only under its official list area, not treated as individually required; totalCreditRequired remains 0 so no graduation completion percentage is produced. The source spellings are preserved exactly, including BMED3011 'Basic Theoryand Practice', MATH3320 'Foundation of Data Analysis' and MATH4280 'Innovation and Design in Big Data Analysis', rather than silently replacing them with similarly named Mathematics-department catalogue wording. University/College General Education, Languages, constitutional-order requirements, Digital Literacy, Physical Education and open Free Electives are not expanded.
